name: 15 km Japan: native eligibility before joining, partial/full cost, one real AI turn and two save/load boundaries

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()
local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

steps.code: local bad={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do if not p:IsHuman() then local gs=p:GetGovernors(); for row in GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas() do local def=GameInfo.Governors[row.GovernorType]; if gs:HasGovernor(def.Hash) and Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..row.LeaderType..'_OWNER')~=p:GetID() then local g=gs:GetGovernor(def.Hash); bad[#bad+1]=p:GetID()..'/'..row.LeaderType..'/nativeType='..tostring(g and g:GetType()) end end end end; if #bad>0 then error('AI appointed unjoined personas after native turn: '..table.concat(bad,',')) end; return 'native AI appointment gate verified after first turn'

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive()

local d=GameInfo.Governors[GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas.LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE.GovernorType]; local gs=Players[0]:GetGovernors(); return gs:CanEverAppointGovernor(d.Hash) and (gs:HasGovernor(d.Hash) or gs:CanAppointGovernor(d.Hash))

steps.code: JAC_AppointLeader('LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE'); return 'native appointment/payment requested'

local l='LEADER_JAC_DATE_TANEMUNE'; local r=GameInfo.JAC_LeaderPersonas[l]; local p=Players[0]; local gs=p:GetGovernors();
if Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_EVOLUTION_COST')~=2 or Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_'..l..'_EVOLUTION_SURCHARGE')~=1 then error('evolution cost or surcharge differs') end
local g=gs:HasGovernor(GameInfo.Governors[r.GovernorType].Hash) and gs:GetGovernor(GameInfo.Governors[r.GovernorType].Hash);
if not g or not g:HasPromotion(GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[r.BasePromotionType].Hash) then error('native governor/base absent') end
for payment=1,1 do local def=GameInfo.GovernorPromotions[r.BasePromotionType..'_TITLE_'..payment]; if not def or not g:HasPromotion(def.Hash) then error('native extra title unpaid: '..payment) end end
if gs:GetGovernorPoints()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_DATE_TOTAL_BEFORE') or gs:GetGovernorPointsSpent()~=Game:GetProperty('JAC_PERSONA_SCENARIO_DATE_SPENT_BEFORE')+2 then error('cost2 must increase native spent titles by two') end
for _,u in p:GetUnits():Members() do local gp=u:GetGreatPerson(); local individual=gp and gp:IsGreatPerson() and GameInfo.GreatPersonIndividuals[gp:GetIndividual()]; if individual and individual.GreatPersonIndividualType==r.PersonType then error('Great Person survived evolution') end end
if ExposedMembers.JAC_LeaderPersona.PrepareEvolution(0,l)~='ALREADY_EVOLVED' then error('evolution charged again') end
return 'native governor and per-person cost verified'
